findings.defect: The source says silence settled all around in an instant. The translation omits both the surrounding, enveloping image and the abrupt timing.
findings.rationale: The source specifies that silence descended throughout the area at once; the accepted baseline preserved those details.
findings.replacement: In an instant, silence settled all around them.

findings.current: Now he smiled at the boy who had grown so much.
findings.defect: The source describes the boy as having grown dazzlingly. “So much” conveys the extent of his growth but loses the source’s vivid characterization.
findings.rationale: 눈부시게 성장한 carries a bright, dazzling emphasis, which the accepted baseline also retained with “so brilliantly.”
findings.replacement: Now he smiled at the boy who had grown so brilliantly.

summary: The assembled chapter is broadly faithful, with two minor losses of source imagery.
